nusmp.skill.book_transmutation.descripti: Grey's attribute: take a substance apart and put it back together as something else - ground into iron spikes, ground into sand, an enemy's spell into your own mana and a bed of flowers, a blessing into its curse. Cast it and the Alchemist's Gilded Plate forges over you: brass and iron engraved with glowing circles, a great circle turning behind your back. Summon your grimoire, select a page, and press the skill key to cast.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.iron_spike: Transmutation: Iron Spikes - the ground ahead is turned to iron and thrust up in a line of spikes, each cutting and weakening what stands on it. The line is longer for a bigger spell; damage scales with your EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.magic_conv: Magic Convert - a transmutation circle in front of you for two seconds; every enemy shot that touches it bursts into flowers and becomes your mana (and a little Absorption).
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.quagmire: Transmutation: Quagmire - the ground where you aim turns to sand for five seconds; everything in it sinks, slows and is dragged down, with a little damage.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.grand_tran: Grand Transmutation - every blessing on the foes around you is turned into its curse and you take the blessings; the Alchemist's Gilded Plate forms for five seconds.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemic_b: Transmutation: Alchemic Blades - three to five blades of iron and brass circle you for ten seconds and lunge at the nearest foe within twelve blocks, one cut each, then return. More blades for more EP.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.flowering: Transmutation: Flowering - as Grey and Gauche turned the tendrils into flowers: in seven blocks the foes' shots and the other casters' constructs become flowers, allies lose harmful effects and are healed. Flowers grow for ten seconds.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.transmuted: Transmutation: Transmuted Sentinel - a two-block golem of iron and stone, circles engraved on it, rises at your side for thirty seconds, follows you and strikes the nearest foe. One at a time.
nusmp.page.book_transmutation.alchemist_: Alchemist's Armour - the Gilded Plate for twenty seconds: eleven pieces of brass and iron forge in on your body, a great circle turns behind you, and a fifth of every blow (more with EP, at most 35 percent) is taken off. Resistance I.
